review_candidates.requirements_excerpt: In your new role as a Senior User Terminal Systems Engineer, you will provide technical expertise in the development of equipment, software and systems related to the development of LEO Lightspeed user terminals (UT). The ideal candidate will bring a deep knowledge and expertise in Air Interface protocols/procedures, software architecture, UT operations and System Functionality. This role focuses on technical aspects related to the development, validation, and deployment of user terminals including modem, antenna and RF components for an integrated UT that will meet the overall system requirements and market use cases. Main Responsibilities Define and Evolve UT Systems: Develop and maintain technical requirements and architectural frameworks for Telesat Lightspeed user terminal ensuring alignment with system-level performance goals and operational concepts.
